## Purpose

What approved issue or milestone does this address?

## Production quality gate (required for game art / scene / vehicle changes)

Review the [Production Standard](../docs/PRODUCTION_STANDARD.md) and use the [Asset Review Template](../docs/ASSET_REVIEW_TEMPLATE.md). For NF-H01 follow the existing locked [hero craft gate sequence](../docs/HERO_CRAFT_BUILD_ORDER.md).

- **Asset/scene ID and version:**
- **Current gate and approval status:** NOT_STARTED / IN_PROGRESS / NEEDS_REVISION / BLOCKED / APPROVED
- **Evidence record and actual Blender source URL:**
- **Visual approval from owner, or clearly labeled EXPERIMENT/PREVIEW:**
- [ ] Real-model clay/wire/beauty evidence attached for applicable gate
- [ ] Optimized mesh, UV/PBR/LOD and Blender-vs-Unity comparison attached where applicable
- [ ] Android device profile attached for production performance claims
- [ ] No production asset promoted based only on screenshots, an APK compiling, or an unreviewed generated model

## Verification

- [ ] Repository and Godot smoke tests pass
- [ ] Relevant Mobile/Vulkan views inspected
- [ ] Android device performance checked for gameplay changes
- [ ] No signing credentials or unapproved third-party assets introduced

## Status

What is completed, tested, planned or blocked?
